The battle with your Security Digimon happens after the activation of [On Play] effects on played Digimon or "When you play a Digimon" effects.
Card Q&A.q: Does this cards [Security] effect play 1 level 6 Digimon card with [Etemon] in its name from my hand before or after the battle with my Security Digimon?

Effect: [Security] If you have 3 or more cards with [Sukamon] in their names in your trash, you may play 1 level 6 Digimon card with [Etemon] in its name from your hand without paying the cost.
[On Deletion] Place this card at the bottom of your security stack.
Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] Place 1 [Etemon] from your trash at the bottom of your security stack.
